picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Viridian collected three takeaways and still lost. I expect the defense to give the Titans another chance, and the offense to use enough of it.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Celadon managed four third-down conversions against Cinnabar. I trust that capacity to sustain a few drives against a less imposing opponent.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Both clubs have five wins and recent trouble finishing possessions. Their available evidence supports a low-scoring tie as my best single score judgment.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Viridian’s passing game avoided interceptions against Pewter. Celadon just spent a full afternoon failing to answer Cinnabar’s scoring, and I expect another limited output.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Titans’ clean passing turnover line and useful Gabite carries give them a small advantage if they defend the final possession better.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Cinnabar has beaten Blackthorn, Mt. Silver and Celadon in succession. Pewter’s comeback was admirable; the three giveaways make another recovery much harder here.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Gholdengo took no sacks on thirty-five attempts. That protection should let Cinnabar keep testing a defense that could not turn Viridian’s low output into an easy win.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Pewter showed a late response rather than folding at Viridian. I still favor Cinnabar’s repeated receiving production, but give the home side two touchdowns.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Blaine has Glalie catching everything useful and Gholdengo distributing without sack losses. Pewter’s three-turnover afternoon is a dreadful preparation for that assignment.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Blaze’s passing efficiency and better recent opponents favor another win. Pewter needs a much cleaner possession count than it supplied last week.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Cerulean completed useful passes against Saffron and avoided interceptions. I think that offense can beat a Vermilion team whose nine wins have required considerable restraint from its scoring.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: The Tide ran only six times and converted one of five third downs. Vermilion can keep the game short enough for its defense to decide it.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Cerulean’s passing line was better than its final margin against Saffron. I expect the home offense to find more repeatable gains against the Volts.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Vermilion has just finished a close game successfully. Cerulean needs several things to go right and has not shown enough sustained offense to make its own part likely.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Volts’ recent seventeen-point win and secured berth support a modest edge. Cerulean can threaten through the air but must improve its possession length.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Saffron followed seventy points with four more touchdowns and no turnovers. Fuchsia’s three-win offense offers little evidence that it can disrupt that control.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Skattebo’s short scoring runs give Saffron an answer beyond its receivers. Fuchsia will have to defend the full possession, and I do not expect it to do so repeatedly.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Fuchsia kept Vermilion within three points. Saffron is substantially stronger, but a final-round game can still contain several ordinary scoring interruptions for the favorite.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: The Psi Corps have conceded eight points a game across sixteen weeks. Fuchsia’s recent fourteen against Vermilion does not persuade me it reaches the end zone here.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Saffron’s combination of efficient passing, short-yardage finishing and strong defense supports a large margin against an opponent with three wins.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Azalea could not convert a third down even with two takeaways helping. Olivine’s offense is limited, but this opponent gives it a workable route to the berth.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: The Ironclads allowed only ten points to Cianwood. Their defense can keep the game within reach while the offense works around Gogoat’s absence.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Olivine’s new backfield absence follows a three-point performance. Azalea’s kicking supplied all nine points last week; one touchdown alongside it could change this result.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: The Swarm’s offense turned eleven third downs into eleven failures. Olivine does not need brilliance to win this particular final examination.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Olivine’s passing completion rate was respectable despite its poor total. Against an Azalea offense struggling to extend drives, a modest improvement should be sufficient.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Mt. Silver produced 453 yards and never punted at Azalea. Cianwood’s three-completion win gives the Reds a substantial offensive advantage even with a receiving absence.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Gurdurr’s late takeaways and Cianwood’s five sacks show a defense capable of resistance. I still favor the Reds’ protection and more dependable passing.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Crushers have earned a meaningful finale through defense and Bibarel’s persistence. Mt. Silver remains the better team, though the new receiving injuries make a smaller margin sensible.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Crem Ftzpatrik has just thrown three touchdowns without taking a sack. Cianwood will need far more than three completions to answer the Reds at home.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Mt. Silver’s passing distribution and rushing support should create more sustained offense. Cianwood’s quarterback availability improves, but its actual lineup and passing recovery remain uncertain.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Mahogany stayed competitive with Blackthorn while Violet gave away four passes. The Falcons’ new rushing absence makes an immediate offensive repair less convincing.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Violet’s worst damage came from passing mistakes and short opportunities. I expect a more conservative game against Mahogany to preserve enough scoring chances.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Falcons still have a concrete route and a home game. Mahogany can make it difficult, but Violet has enough recent wins before the collapse to earn a narrow recovery pick.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Four interceptions and a lost Zangoose contribution are a poor foundation for a must-improve afternoon. Mahogany’s nineteen against Blackthorn is the stronger recent scoring evidence.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Violet should face less passing pressure from the scoreboard than it did against Lavender. I expect fewer risky throws and enough touchdowns to keep its playoff route alive.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Lavender’s five passing touchdowns came without a sack or interception. Blackthorn recovered at Mahogany, but its recent defensive volatility makes me favor the Wails at home.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: The Wails can pressure a Blackthorn offense missing two backs while giving Moth Ball multiple receiving outlets. That combination should produce a clearer margin than the records alone suggest.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Lavender has kept winning through its quarterback absence and now gets the division opportunity at home. Hatterene’s recovery makes me expect a game decided by one late possession.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Hatterene completed twenty-one of twenty-eight at Mahogany. I trust that sharper passing to test Lavender more effectively than Violet’s four-interception offense did.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Moth Ball’s protection and Luvdisc’s repeated availability give Lavender a slight scoring edge. Blackthorn can answer through Hatterene, but its backfield absences reduce the margin for stalled drives.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Dewford stopped all eight Mauville third downs. Rustboro’s two interceptions and sixty-eight rushing yards leave the Breakers with a plausible route to another narrow defensive win.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: I trust Dewford’s protection after zero sacks allowed more than Rustboro’s reliance on one receiver for most of its passing yards. The Breakers can make the Stone repeat difficult downs.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Rustboro outgained Petalburg despite the defeat. Watzon’s earlier ball security gives me a reason to expect a cleaner response rather than another two-interception game.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: The Stone forced six punts against a division champion. Dewford needed a ninety-nine-yard return to reach twenty-one, and I doubt that scoring shortcut repeats.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Dewford’s third-down defense and efficient limited passing give it a small advantage. Rustboro should move the ball, but its finishing must improve to reverse last week’s result.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Mauville’s passing yards did not become points at Dewford, but Petalburg has just lost its most productive runner from the title-clinching game. I expect the Dynamos to use that opening.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Petalburg’s eight pass breakups and two interceptions are concrete defensive strengths. Mauville’s zero-for-eight third downs make me favor Norman’s defense in another narrow game.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Pride have kept finishing difficult games even with modest offensive totals. Oinkologne’s absence narrows the advantage, but I still trust the home defense for one decisive stop.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Whiscash gained minus-two yards on twelve carries while Oinkologne supplied the explosive work. Removing Oinkologne gives Mauville a much clearer way to control the game.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Togekiss has enough receiving production to improve on thirteen points, and Petalburg’s new backfield absence reduces its own scoring flexibility. I favor Mauville by a field goal.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Mossdeep held Sootopolis to six first downs with a different quarterback doing the passing. Lavaridge’s seven points against Fortree do not support a substantial scoring challenge.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Seven sacks and 136 yards allowed show the Eclipse’s defensive standard survived the lineup changes. Holt’s absence matters, but the defense should keep the remaining offense’s task manageable.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Lavaridge has three consecutive wins and Mossdeep has lost a productive runner. I still favor the unbeaten team, while expecting more resistance than its season averages imply.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: The Eclipse’s offense produced twenty-two against Sootopolis and now loses Holt. I expect a closer finale than the unbeaten record encourages, though the defense should preserve it.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Mossdeep’s protection and ball security need improvement, but its defense repeatedly ends possessions. Lavaridge’s recent low-scoring win makes that advantage decisive in my forecast.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Sootopolis faced the league’s strongest unbeaten defense. Fortree managed three against Lavaridge, so I give the Surge’s recent struggles a little more context.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: The Skyhawks kept Lavaridge to seven, but their own scoring remains thin. Sootopolis can win through a modest protection improvement and a few Pawmo completions.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Fortree’s defense gave it a real chance last week. At home against another struggling offense, I expect enough additional scoring to finish one close game successfully.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: The Surge have six wins and a receiver who produced sixty-three yards at Mossdeep. Fortree’s three-point offense has supplied very little reason for a generous forecast.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Sootopolis has the stronger season record and faced a much harder defense last week. I expect its passing game to operate more comfortably here.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Slowking’s three touchdown passes give Canalave a route even after the rushing injuries. Oreburgh’s ten points against Eterna leave the Bulwark a manageable scoring target.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Canalave lost the runner who supplied sixty yards and another newly injured contributor. Oreburgh’s recent defensive resistance can make those missing touches decisive.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Bulwark have kept their season alive through a close win. I expect Slowking’s recent touchdown production to supply just enough against a three-win opponent.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Canalave’s eight wins conceal an offense now missing more useful players. Oreburgh can exploit the reduced rushing options and force Slowking to carry too much.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Canalave’s passing game finished three touchdowns last week without an interception. That gives the visitors a narrow edge despite their newly weakened rushing group.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Tatsugiri’s absence changes the offense of a team that won with fifteen points. Snowpoint’s twenty-one at Canalave offers a plausible upset route against a reduced scoring margin.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Eterna’s defense has been the steadier part of its ten-win season. I expect it to keep Snowpoint low enough for the available offense to survive.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Thorns have earned their title, but a new quarterback absence asks for an immediate adjustment. Snowpoint has enough recent scoring to win a very narrow game.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Eterna has scored 205 points in sixteen games before losing its quarterback. Snowpoint does not need a dramatic transformation to outscore that reduced attack.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The new Tatsugiri absence makes Eterna’s offensive continuity uncertain. Snowpoint’s recent three-touchdown output earns a small edge despite the Thorns’ stronger defense.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Pastoria punted eight times and produced five first downs. Hearthome’s recent rushing support should give the Haunts enough possession control to finish their own part of the race.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Feraligatr supplied ninety-seven yards while the defense held Veilstone to seven. I expect that balance to create repeated difficult passing downs for the Waves.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Hearthome has kept its season relevant through useful late results. Pastoria can respond after a poor game, but the Haunts have the steadier current contributions.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: The Haunts remain below .500 and should not receive an effortless victory in the forecast. Pastoria’s offense was poor, yet a modest recovery can keep this within one possession.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Hearthome’s running game and recent defensive result provide the better foundation. Pastoria must improve both protection and third downs before I expect enough points to win.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Watzon found three touchdown throws without an interception at Pastoria. Veilstone’s seven-point response at Hearthome does not suggest it can match that production.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Sunyshore held Pastoria to one conversion in nine third downs. The Fists’ recent offensive struggles give the Starseekers a similar route to sustained defensive control.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The visitors have earned twelve wins and just repaired their passing game. I expect Veilstone to offer some home resistance while Sunyshore’s stronger balance decides it.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: I still want to see Sunyshore repeat this against a leading defense. Veilstone’s current scoring and Kricketune absence make this a much easier assignment.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Starseekers have multiple receivers producing useful yardage and a defense that just forced eight punts. Veilstone’s limited recent offense leaves a clear gap.
